purpose: UD-U0 artifact identity pins for the dense UD Q4_K_S / Q4_K_M campaign (docs/UD-QUANTS.md section 3 and U0). Establishes which bytes the audit snapshot in UD-QUANTS-REVIEW-v2.json inspected and which published artifact each local file equals. Diagnostic identity evidence only: not model admission and not a performance claim.

evidence_policy.payload_sha256: Full-file SHA256 values are prior pinned evidence: K_M from docs/QWEN38-UD-Q4KM-GFX11-CAMPAIGN.md, plain K_M and K_S supplied and verified against the official pinned GitLFS pointers in the parent session. This U0 pass did not rehash any 15-17 GB payload; it refetched the three tiny LFS pointers at the pinned revisions (2026-09-07) and re-checked local file sizes.
evidence_policy.header_identity: Computed 2026-09-07 by scripts/gguf_quant_route_audit.py (schema v2): SHA256 over raw file bytes [0, data_start_bytes) where data_start is production scan_gguf's tensor_data_offset (tensor-info table end aligned up to general.alignment). Covers magic, version, metadata, descriptor table and alignment padding; excludes every tensor payload byte. Metadata identity, not model bytes. The plain K_M value reproduces the historical docs/UD-QUANTS-REVIEW.json header hash byte-for-byte.
evidence_policy.published_equality: Matching published size + prior full-payload hash + matching current local size establishes published payload equality, not original download history.

header_identity.boundary: sha256 over raw file bytes [0, data_start_bytes): GGUF magic, version, metadata, tensor-info table and the alignment padding after it; excludes every tensor payload byte (metadata identity, not model bytes)
